shortDescription.default: Brillienta CRM in Microsoft 365 Copilot: pipeline, accounts, renewals, invoices, cases and new leads.

longDescription.default: Adds the Brillienta CRM agent to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Six tools show live CRM data as interactive cards: your pipeline with AI deal health, a 360 summary of any account, subscriptions renewing soon, overdue invoices, support cases at risk of breaching their SLA, and a reviewable new-lead form. Requires Brillienta CRM (brillienta-crm.sppkg) on a SharePoint site; every answer uses the signed-in person's own CRM permissions.

features.title: Brillienta CRM Copilot
features.description: Deploys the Brillienta CRM Copilot Components and agent.
